title: Fernhill Garden Show looks
brief: I'm the organizer of the Fernhill Garden Show, and our committee has to choose how the show's page should look. We will sit around a table with the page projected, so please show the same content three times, side by side, in three different looks, each labeled. The content: the show runs 2027-05-14 to 2027-05-16 at Fernhill Park; tickets are adult 14 dollars, concession 9 dollars, and children under 12 free; the highlights are Friday 10:00 opening by the mayor, Saturday 11:00 rose pruning demonstration, and Sunday 14:00 children's seed workshop. A note says Saturday tickets sell out, so book ahead. Look 1 is called "Botanical": deep green #1F4D3A on cream #F6F1E4, an elegant serif for headings, generous space. Look 2 is called "Poster": bold sunflower yellow #FFC400 with black #111111, very large heavy headings, tight and loud. Look 3 is called "Quiet": almost all white #FFFFFF with slate #3C4A57 text and thin lines, small neat type. Under each look, list its colors with their hex values. Add a short "Which to choose" section from me: Botanical suits our older visitors, Poster suits social media, Quiet suits printing, and I lean towards Botanical.

edit.request: Add a fourth look called "Retro": orange #E8590C on off-white #FFF4E6 with rounded friendly lettering, and change the Saturday demonstration time to 12:30.
